user.title: Add a car
user.description: Configure one car. Add the integration again for another car. Runtime is calculated automatically from the outdoor temperature using engine-focused recommendations: no heating above +10 °C and at most 180 minutes.

data.name: Car name
data.post_departure_enabled: Continue heating for 30 minutes after departure
data.temperature_max_age_hours: Warn when the temperature reading is older than

data_description.event_titles: Enter complete event titles, one per line or separated by commas. For example: TILL JOBBET. Spaces are allowed.
data_description.event_keywords: Enter words, phrases or tags, one per line or separated by commas. Any single title or word/tag can match. Capitalization is ignored.
data_description.power_entity: Choose the plug's power sensor in W or kW. It is used to estimate energy consumption and warn when power is low.
data_description.power_min_watts: Power below this threshold is considered low.
data_description.power_delay_minutes: Warn only after power has remained low for this long while the heater is on.
data_description.notify_entity: Choose a notification entity, such as your phone, to also receive a push notification. When alerts are enabled, Home Assistant always receives a notification.
data_description.post_departure_enabled: Keep scheduled heating on for 30 minutes after departure, in addition to pre-departure heating. Does not apply to Start now; the temperature limit still applies.
data_description.power_alarm_enabled: Warn when the heater is on but power remains below the threshold. Turning this off does not disable energy monitoring.
data_description.weather_entity: Use hourly forecasts for estimated future calendar times. The measured outdoor temperature still controls the heater.
data_description.energy_price_entity: If selected, the sensor price at the end of the session is used for an estimate and takes priority over the fixed price.
data_description.energy_price: Set a fixed price per kWh in the selected currency. Leave empty to disable estimated costs.
data_description.energy_currency: Three-letter currency code, such as SEK or EUR.
data_description.operation_alerts_enabled: Notify in Home Assistant and the selected notification target when the switch, temperature or calendar has a problem.
data_description.temperature_max_age_hours: Set to 0 to disable age warnings. Sensors report at different intervals.

error.missing_calendar_rule: Enter a title, word or tag for the selected calendar.
error.duplicate_switch: This switch is already used by another car.
error.invalid_currency: Enter a three-letter currency code, such as SEK.

init.title: Edit car settings
init.description: Choose the car's switch, outdoor sensor and optional calendar. Clear the calendar field to disable calendar departures. Runtime is calculated automatically from the outdoor temperature using engine-focused recommendations: no heating above +10 °C and at most 180 minutes.
